title: Reviewer-MCP tests: replace the module-local await_event with the shared phase_sync::receive
outcome: The reviewer-MCP test files wait through the shared fixture helper (tests::phase_sync::receive / receive_before_cleanup) instead of a second module-local helper, so the fixtures keep one liveness-guard convention. Timeout panics report the waiting call site (no ineffective #[track_caller]), and the doc comments say the waits are bounded by the shared 60 s TEST_PHASE_DEADLOCK_GUARD.
acceptance: Reviewer-MCP tests: replace the module-local await_event with the shared phase_sync::receive is done
